d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne aaj darbhanga men 105 yojnaon ka udghatan aur shilanyas kiya. sath hi jile ki vikas yojnaon ki samiksha kar karyon men teji lane aur nirdharit samay-sima men pura karne ka nirdesh diya. siem ne 54ven mithila vibhuti parv samaroh ki shuruaat karne ke sath-sath kila parisar sthit prasiddh man shyama maee mandir men darshan-pujan bhi kiya.
